title: Penalty for Subsequent Contravention of False or Misleading Advertisement

content.scenario: A company, previously fined for publishing a false advertisement about the health benefits of their product, releases another advertisement making similar unsubstantiated claims. The consumer protection authority discovers this and decides to take action.
content.outcome: The company is fined fifty lakh rupees for the subsequent contravention, as per the provisions for punishment of such offenses.
